fields.FIR_Description: During the evening of 2026-05-02, around 17:05, the complainant found the pocket emptied of cash (about Rs. 2,200) after boarding a crowded bus near Kurinji Puram Railway Station Road, according to the complaint recorded on 2026-05-02. Durga Raman submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000103. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Sanjay Palanisamy, using the number 9000000215. A further person, Dinesh Balan, a relative of the suspect, using the number 9000000363, is stated to be associated with the incident. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Wallet allegedly lifted from a pocket in a crowded queue.
fields.Keywords: pickpocketing, wallet, associate, railway station road, evening, CCTV, mobile number, suspect
